title: Show the pickup time on the order confirmation
body:
### summary

As a customer collecting an order, I want the confirmation to show my pickup time, so that I know when to come to the shop.

### completion_goal

1. [screenshot] state: the order confirmation after the seeded customer pays for the 09:30 pickup slot on Saturday 17 October; expected: the order number and "Pickup Sat 17 Oct, 09:30" under it
2. [api-trace] state: GET /api/orders/1001 for the seeded order; expected: 200 with pickup_at "2026-10-17T09:30:00+01:00"
3. [screenshot] state: the same confirmation at 390 px wide; expected: the order number and the pickup time show without horizontal scrolling

### measure

Completion Goal criteria observed

### threshold

3 of 3

### scenario

As the seeded customer, order one loaf for the 09:30 Saturday slot, pay with the seeded test card, and look at the confirmation at 1280 px and 390 px; call GET /api/orders/1001.

### environment

local app with the seeded customer and the payment stub; never production
